svg.title: How a cluck is placed on screen
svg.desc: Three panels. First, five chicken positions across and beyond the screen. Second, the level each ear gets for every position: full within one half-screen, then fading to a floor of 0.4, with the pan capped at 0.6 so the far ear never goes silent. Third, how the left and right levels reach the OPL3 pair, an OPL2 card, the Web and the PC speaker.
svg.text: Measured in half-screens from the middle of the view, sideways (dx). 1 is the screen edge.
Up and down count too: loudness uses whichever of dx and dy is further out, but only dx decides left and right.
Pan = 0.6 x dx (never more than 0.6). Loudness is 1 inside the screen, then loses 0.5 per half-screen, never below 0.4.
C is dead centre: both ears at 0.71 (-3 dB), so the middle is as loud as one voice.
Far from the screen the sound is quieter but never lost: at most about 10 dB down on the far ear, and the loudness never drops below 0.4.
